qs.q: A 2-year-old boy has enlargement of the left testis. An ultrasound scan shows a 2 cm solid mass within the body of the testis. Serum AFP is 226 ng/mL. Which of the following neoplasms is this child most likely to have?
qs.e: The most common testicular tumor under the age of 3 is a yolk sac tumor (infantile embryonal carcinoma). However, finding any testicular tumor in children is uncommon. The prognosis is good in most cases.
